patch_description: Add a bounded best-improvement local-search pass after threshold packing. The binary-search feasibility routine finds a strong packing, but its multidimensional best-fit choices can leave avoidable imbalance because it does not reconsider earlier assignments. Relocations and memory-feasible swaps are evaluated against the complete descending KVPR profile: the maximum KVPR remains the primary objective, while the profile deterministically breaks exact maximum-pressure ties. This can escape greedy packing artifacts without changing feasibility guarantees.
